B-H1.name: necessity of attention to N
B-H1.statement: Blocking attention from the post-image text tokens to N raises the Yes - No margin of Correct-No inputs, and raises it more than blocking attention to a P image.

estimates.contrast: mean C under blocking at the selected block band, over confirmation-half block inputs
estimates.n_arm: mean Delta m(N) under the same blocking, same inputs

B-H1.weighting: each input equal weight; image counts and positions pooled

B-H2.name: correction by boosting attention to N
B-H2.statement: Boosting attention from the post-image text tokens to N lowers the Yes - No margin of False-Yes inputs, and lowers it more than boosting attention to a P image.

estimates.contrast: mean C under boosting at the selected boost band, over confirmation-half boost inputs
estimates.n_arm: mean Delta m(N) under the same boosting, same inputs

B-H2.weighting: each input equal weight; image counts and positions pooled

hypotheses.note: B-H1 and B-H2 are decided separately; neither changes any STEP 5-2 / 5-2b decision.

decision.level: 97.5% intervals (Bonferroni for two primary hypotheses), N-image cluster bootstrap
decision.joint_condition_note: Support requires both the contrast condition and the N-arm condition; because both must hold (intersection-union), no further multiplicity adjustment is applied.

B-H1.supported: (1) mean C >= 0.5 AND N-image cluster 97.5% CI lower bound of C > 0; AND (2) mean Delta m(N) > 0 AND N-image cluster 97.5% CI lower bound of Delta m(N) > 0
B-H1.robust_label: 'robust support' only if the class cluster 97.5% CI lower bounds of both C and Delta m(N) are also > 0; otherwise 'support (cross-class generalization uncertain)' (confirmed by the user, 2026-11-13)
B-H1.no_meaningful_difference: N-image cluster 97.5% CI upper bound of C < 0.5
B-H1.otherwise: inconclusive; the unmet condition is stated (contrast, N arm, or both)

B-H2.supported: (1) mean C <= -0.5 AND N-image cluster 97.5% CI upper bound of C < 0; AND (2) mean Delta m(N) < 0 AND N-image cluster 97.5% CI upper bound of Delta m(N) < 0
B-H2.robust_label: 'robust support' only if the class cluster 97.5% CI upper bounds of both C and Delta m(N) are also < 0; otherwise 'support (cross-class generalization uncertain)' (confirmed by the user, 2026-11-13)
B-H2.no_meaningful_difference: N-image cluster 97.5% CI lower bound of C > -0.5
B-H2.otherwise: inconclusive; the unmet condition is stated (contrast, N arm, or both)

decision.p_arm_report: Delta m(P_control) for the same inputs and band is always reported with its sign, estimate and 97.5% N-image cluster CI (no decision); it shows whether C comes from the N side or the P side.

statistics.method: percentile cluster bootstrap; 97.5% for B-H1 / B-H2 and the P-arm report, 95% for secondary results (labelled)
statistics.resampling_unit: N image ID within the confirmation half; all inputs of a drawn N image enter together
